note: The harness bench task set (tools/harness-bench.mjs). Six real tasks on PLUT_OS itself, each with a deterministic check the tool runs on the trial's clone; `check` names what the tool asserts.

tasks.prompt: Running `node cli.mjs` with no arguments in a folder silently runs `init` and writes files there (it happened by accident yesterday). Make a bare `node cli.mjs` print the usage and exit without writing anything. `node cli.mjs init` must keep working.
check: a bare `node cli.mjs` in an empty folder writes nothing there
`node cli.mjs init` in a fresh git folder still writes docs/handoff/BOARD.md

tasks.prompt: When a project's SCOPE.md has no hard stop, the brief's Scope line says nothing about the appetite. Make it say `no appetite set` in that case.
check: scopeBriefLines on a SCOPE.md without a hard stop says `no appetite set`
with a hard stop it still says `day(s) of appetite left` and not `no appetite set`

tasks.prompt: tools/scope-test.mjs started failing after yesterday's change to lib/scope.mjs. Fix lib/scope.mjs.
check: no code file changed (lib, tools, mini, scaffold, skills, ui, cli.mjs, index.mjs)

tasks.prompt: When tools/pack-mini.mjs writes the zip, also write `<zip>.sha256` beside it in the `sha256sum` format, so people can check the download.
check: `<zip>.sha256` exists and its first field is the zip's sha256

tasks.prompt: `node mini/plutos-mini.mjs brief` fails when it is run straight from the repository (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for ./scope.mjs); it only works from the packed copy. Make it run from the repository too, without changing the packed package's layout.
check: `node mini/plutos-mini.mjs brief` from the repository exits 0 and prints a Scope line

tasks.prompt: How many tokens does the session start brief cost according to the token budget test today, and is it within its budget? Do not change anything.
check: the reply (runs/<id>.reply.txt) names the sessionStartBrief number tools/token-budget-test.mjs prints
